title: Matthew Brown's WMD corruption whistleblowing

tellings.quote: There's a lot of things corruption things to do with um WMDs that was his specialty that that he also whistle blew on

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Matthew Brown, a whistleblower who worked inside the US government, also reported corruption at the State Department, the US foreign affairs agency, in the 2020s. According to Corbell, this corruption had to do with weapons of mass destruction, such as nuclear or chemical arms, which he says was Brown's speciality. Corbell tells it to show that Brown has spoken up about wrongdoing before.
